task: Pick up the CUP and place it on the TABLE.
plan_summary: Navigate the CAR to the CUP, pick it up, navigate to the TABLE, and place the CUP on the TABLE.
assumptions: The coordinates of the CUP and TABLE are reachable.
The CAR can accurately pick up the CUP when in range.
A tolerance of 1.0 is sufficient to be within the 2.0 interaction distance of the objects.
rtdl: def task PickAndPlace(;){ state nav_cup_success: bool; state nav_cup_msg: string; state pick_success: bool; state pick_msg: string; state nav_table_success: bool; state nav_table_msg: string; state place_success: bool; state place_msg: string; sequence{ do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=2.0,y=2.0,tolerance=1.0;success->nav_cup_success,message->nav_cup_msg); check(nav_cup_success == true); do Pick(robot_name="CAR",object_name="CUP";success->pick_success,message->pick_msg); check(pick_success == true); do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=-2.0,y=2.0,tolerance=1.0;success->nav_table_success,message->nav_table_msg); check(nav_table_success == true); do Place(robot_name="CAR",object_name="CUP",location_name="TABLE";success->place_success,message->place_msg); check(place_success == true); } }
